text:
arjun: Heads up — p95 RTT between GPU nodes in cluster-r1 spiked during the late-afternoon batching window (17:00-17:25). Went from ~90ms to 1.1s. Not seeing CPU/GPU saturation. @ops-oncall

ops-oncall: got alerts. interface rx_errors rising on node-gpu-23 and node-gpu-27. Packet-loss 0.8-2%. Kicking off captures.

jenna: pulling ethtool/stats now. ifconfig shows MTU 9000 on both, but ethtool shows tx_ring drops. snippet:
```
# on node-gpu-23
ip link show enp3s0f0
3: enp3s0f0: <BROADCAST,MULTICAST,UP,LOWER_UP> mtu 9000 qdisc mq state UP mode DEFAULT group default qlen 1000
```

jenna: ethtool -S shows tx_drops 312 during window.

infra-bot: incident INC-2024-343 created by ops-oncall — "inter-node RTT surge — cluster-r1" <https://redwood.internal/inc/INC-2024-343>

maya: KV cache misses jumped at same time; requests falling back to small-batch path which increases tail latency.

sam: ran tcpdump for a minute, saw repeated retransmits and MSS mismatches. example:
```
12:17:02.123456 IP 10.2.5.23.45012 > 10.2.8.27.45012: Flags [P.], seq 32793:33012, ack 9811, win 64240, length 219
12:17:02.123457 IP 10.2.8.27 > 10.2.5.23: ICMP frag needed, mtu 1500
```

arjun: interesting — looks like a path intermittently using 1500 MTU. TOR 10.1.24.5 had a config change around 16:58 per netcfg logs.

jenna: scheduling iperf3 test now between the two nodes: `iperf3 -c 10.2.8.27 -t 30 -P 4` — will post results.

ops-oncall: verified: TOR change was a QoS rule tweak (queue-limit) during a rolling upgrade. change-id cfg-2024-782. rolling staged across rack-3 at 16:55-17:05.

maya: Ops — can we mark KV-cache warmup affinity to avoid cross-rack hops until we validate network path? temporary mitigation.

sam: quick mitigation plan:
- revert QoS tweak on TOR 10.1.24.5
- force ECMP hash to avoid path flaps (`sysctl net.ipv4.fib_multipath_hash_policy=1`)
- disable LRO/GRO on NIC as test (`ethtool -K enp3s0f0 gro off lro off`)

arjun: I'll run the ethtool change on the two nodes and re-run pings/iperf. If reroute improves, we'll coordinate a controlled rollback of the TOR change.

jenna: iperf3 results: throughput drop and high jitter during the window, 9.8Gbps -> 2.1Gbps, retransmits 1.4%

ops-oncall: rollback scheduled and applied at 17:12. Monitoring p95 now.

maya: p95 back down to 120ms after rollback. KV cache misses trending down. :tada:

sam: follow-up actions:
- open ticket to validate MTU consistency end-to-end
- add short test (iperf+ping) before rolling QoS changes in rack
- add alert for ICMP-frag-needed events

arjun: thanks team. will collect full pcaps and open a postmortem if we see recurrence.

devex-ryan: noted — will update runbook with the QoS preflight checklist.

ops-oncall: closing incident INC-2024-343; re-open if it happens again. :white_check_mark:
